Use case: stylized-concept (new character designed from a style reference).
Asset type: enemy class character turnaround concept for the cartoon beach comedy game Beatch Slash!.
Input image: Assets/ConceptArt/Enemies/enemy_turnaround.png is the STYLE, LAYOUT and HEAD-SIZE reference only (same game, same illustration language). The character below is a NEW, different woman, not a recolor or a small edit of the reference.
Create one 1536x1024 landscape sheet with exactly three full-body views of the SAME clearly ADULT woman, about 25-35 years old: FRONT, strict RIGHT-facing SIDE PROFILE, BACK. Same stylized large-head compact cartoon proportions as the reference: same head size and same total height unless stated below. Full bodies uncropped, crowns and soles aligned across the views, relaxed neutral standing A-pose with arms slightly apart, barefoot, technical turnaround, generous even spacing, uniform flat light gray background, no floor line, no cast shadows. Identical anatomy, hairstyle and swimwear construction in all three views; the back view must show the real back of the hair and of the swimwear.
Rendering: polished simple 2D concept art, clean dark warm-brown outline, flat colors with simple clearly bounded 3-tone cel shading, no gradients, no photorealism, no pixelation, no text, labels, logos or borders.
Clothing: tasteful ordinary opaque beachwear, bust and crotch fully covered, always clothed, no nudity, no transparency. Keep hair and swimsuit each in a few clearly bounded flat tones (they will be recolored in the game); do not use swimsuit colors close to skin tone (pink, orange, yellow). Skin, eyes and outline are fixed.
Small-sprite readability: the silhouette must be recognizable when shrunk to a 64x64 pixel sprite, so use large simple shapes and ONE strong distinguishing feature; avoid thin decorative details.
